# platform-orchestrator_resource_type_version (Data Source)

Reads an exact immutable Resource Type interface. The version is an interface number, not the catalogue resource_version used for concurrency.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "platform-orchestrator_resource_type_version" "storage" {
  resource_type_id = "storage"
  version          = 2
}

output "storage_interface_uuid" {
  value = data.platform-orchestrator_resource_type_version.storage.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_type_id` (String)
- `version` (Number) Exact positive interface version; never resolves latest.

### Read-Only

- `module_contract` (String) Optional Module declaration contract as JSON. Absence remains null.
- `output_schema` (String) Exact output contract as JSON.
- `uuid` (String) Immutable interface UUID retained by bound Module Versions.
